_what: The standard set: pictures and sounds an author can put into a visual novel without drawing. Studio-side, never in the template tree — a set of any size would bloat every game — and copied into a game when picked, one file, one commit. `file` is the path under public/story-art/; where it lands in a game is by kind, keeping the file name: backgrounds to assets/images/, portraits to assets/sprites/, sounds to assets/sounds/. `examples` are whole stories the story editor's guide can put in, each naming the art it uses.

mila.title: The Light at the Back of the House
mila.what: Six scenes, two people, a cat, a switch, and two endings.
